'''Tan Dicium''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Prince/Legends|princeling]] from [[Sifuchi]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he traveled to [[Tirahnn/Legends|Tirahnn]] to visit the [[Great Fair|Great Tirahnn Fair]] along with his four [[Yuzzem]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]].<ref name="Triplet" />
